visual_inspection: Coherent cat holding a readable hello world sign; informal functional check only
phase_clock: std::chrono::system_clock; not CUDA events or monotonic time
phase_semantics: encode includes conditioning and latent/schedule setup before denoise; decode excludes final tensor-to-image conversion. Do not equate encode directly to isolated text encoder time.
e2e_clock: Upstream steady_clock around ed_generate_image; PNG saving excluded; printed per-pass seconds rounded to milliseconds
unusable_stage_fields: timing.json time_wo_decoding and time_with_decoding duplicate e2e total; do not use as stages
